mentions.name: OSle
mentions.description: A minimal operating system that fits entirely within a single 510-byte bootloader, deliberately avoiding chain loading or multi-stage boot. It includes a file system, a shell, and simple process management, enough to run non-trivial guest applications such as a text editor. Progress is public on GitHub and it can be tested in the browser.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I started making an OS that fits in a bootloader.

I am purposefully not doing chain loading or multi-stage to see how much I can squeeze out of 510bytes.

It comes with a file system, a shell, and a simple process management. Enough to write non-trivial guest applications, like a text editor.
